caseName: Crescent Milling Co. v. H. N. Strait Manufacturing Co.
caseNameFull: Crescent Milling Company v. H. N. Strait Manufacturing Company
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the District of Minnesota.
attorneys: Mr. Harris Richardson for appellant. Mr. John I. Dille and Mr. John O. P. Wheelwright for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of §6 of the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726, 727.
